# Known intentional mechanical mating interfaces: Woodruff keys seat in shaft keyseats, keys
# engage link hub keyway slots, clamp bolt/lock/nut hardware engages link split-clamp lug bores,
# the M568C pin passes through the link B eye bore, and the M569C fork prongs enter the link eye
# bore which is between the SH944A bracket cheeks. All of these overlaps are by design and
# represent intended mechanical fits; zero collision between all NON-mating surfaces is verified

    frozenset({'ClutchSwingShaft_D', 'WoodruffKey1_SH944D'}),      # key seats in shaft

def make_brake_pedal_m764a():
    """M764A brake pedal: malleable-iron casting 35-1/4 in (895.35 mm) long overall, 8 x 5 in pad."""
    bore_dia = 38.10
    boss_od = 58.0
    boss_w = 50.0
    boss = Part.makeCylinder(boss_od / 2.0, boss_w, V(0, -boss_w / 2.0, 0), V(0, 1, 0))
    hole = Part.makeCylinder(bore_dia / 2.0, boss_w + 10.0, V(0, -boss_w / 2.0 - 5.0, 0), V(0, 1, 0))
    boss = boss.cut(hole)
    
    arm = Part.makeBox(25.0, 16.0, 700.0, V(-12.5, -8.0, -700.0))
    arm.Placement = App.Placement(V(0, 0, 0), App.Rotation(V(0, 1, 0), 45.0))
    
    bell_arm = Part.makeBox(25.0, 16.0, 127.0, V(-12.5, -8.0, -127.0))
    bell_arm.Placement = App.Placement(V(0, 0, 0), App.Rotation(V(0, 1, 0), -60.0))
    eye_boss = Part.makeCylinder(28.0 / 2.0, 20.0, V(127.0 * math.sin(math.radians(60)), -10.0, -127.0 * math.cos(math.radians(60))), V(0, 1, 0))
    eye_hole = Part.makeCylinder(13.0 / 2.0, 30.0, V(127.0 * math.sin(math.radians(60)), -15.0, -127.0 * math.cos(math.radians(60))), V(0, 1, 0))
    bell = bell_arm.fuse(eye_boss).cut(eye_hole)
    
    pad_len = 203.2
    pad_w = 127.0
    pad = Part.makeBox(pad_len, pad_w, 12.0, V(-pad_len / 2.0, -pad_w / 2.0, -6.0))
    end_pt = arm.Placement.multVec(V(0, 0, -700.0))
    pad.Placement = App.Placement(end_pt, App.Rotation(V(0, 1, 0), 20.0))
    
    pedal = boss.fuse(arm).fuse(bell).fuse(pad).removeSplitter()
    assert pedal.isValid() and len(pedal.Solids) == 1 and pedal.Solids[0].isClosed()
    assert pedal.Placement.isIdentity()
    return pedal


def make_hand_lever(mark, total_len, bell_len, bell_ang_deg):
    """Parametric hand lever (M772 clutch lever, M777 reverse lever, M758/M759/M756/M757 speed levers)."""
    boss_od = 56.0
    boss_w = 32.0
    bore_dia = 38.10
    boss = Part.makeCylinder(boss_od / 2.0, boss_w, V(0, -boss_w / 2.0, 0), V(0, 1, 0))
    bore = Part.makeCylinder(bore_dia / 2.0, boss_w + 10.0, V(0, -boss_w / 2.0 - 5.0, 0), V(0, 1, 0))
    boss = boss.cut(bore)
    
    h_arm = Part.makeBox(22.0, 16.0, total_len, V(-11.0, -8.0, 0))
    knob = Part.makeSphere(25.0 / 2.0, V(0, 0, total_len))
    upper = h_arm.fuse(knob)
    
    if bell_len > 0:
        b_arm = Part.makeBox(22.0, 16.0, bell_len, V(-11.0, -8.0, -bell_len))
        b_arm.Placement = App.Placement(V(0, 0, 0), App.Rotation(V(0, 1, 0), bell_ang_deg))
        eye_pos = b_arm.Placement.multVec(V(0, 0, -bell_len))
        eye_boss = Part.makeCylinder(26.0 / 2.0, 20.0, eye_pos - V(0, 10.0, 0), V(0, 1, 0))
        eye_hole = Part.makeCylinder(13.0 / 2.0, 30.0, eye_pos - V(0, 15.0, 0), V(0, 1, 0))
        lower = b_arm.fuse(eye_boss).cut(eye_hole)
        lever = boss.fuse(upper).fuse(lower).removeSplitter()
    else:
        lever = boss.fuse(upper).removeSplitter()
        
    assert lever.isValid() and len(lever.Solids) == 1 and lever.Solids[0].isClosed()
    assert lever.Placement.isIdentity()
    return lever
